title: Should standing sessions stop reporting their own use to the coordinator?
why: The rule on standing sessions (triage, batch runners, the arbiter) still has each one report a tally of its own use to the coordinator. Since your no-limit ruling, nothing reads that tally, and the coordinator can read each session's context use itself. The record says dropping the self-report needs your word. Not urgent: the lane that fixes the rotation text does not wait on it.
